title: Maps & Counting
explanation: A List answers what is at position 3. A Map answers what is stored under this key - here, how many of each block id we found.
getOrDefault is the counting idiom: read the current tally, or 0 if this is the first time we have seen that block, then put it back one higher.
entrySet() hands you the key and the value together, which is what you want when printing or sorting a tally.
